{{Top|leg}}
'''Port Melephos''' was a maritime port on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]] continent of [[Alanciar]]. It was located on the northeastern part of [[The Shank]], the southern canal-littered region of Alanciar. Following the [[Invasion of Alanciar]] in [[2975 BBY]], the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Grand Lord]] [[Varner Hilts]]'s airship ''[[Good Omen]]'' visited the port where it was welcomed by the local population after the [[Alanciari]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] man [[Jogan Halder]] convinced the locals the Sith were not a threat.
